engineeringSkip.reason: Neutrino beams interact only via the weak force with vanishingly small cross-sections, so they cannot be focused or used to induce patterned nuclear changes — the concept has no basis in known physics.

factCheck.reason: Neutrinos pass through matter almost without interacting, so a beam cannot be focused or aimed to trigger atomic changes at a chosen spot — the idea has no basis in known physics.
